# SARIF schema

`sarif-2.1.0.json` is the OASIS SARIF 2.1.0 Errata 01 schema, downloaded from:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oasis-tcs/sarif-spec/main/sarif-2.1/schema/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json

The test suite compiles it with `github.com/santhosh-tekuri/jsonschema/v6` and
validates generated output independently of the writer's streaming self-check.
